$comment: Third parties that actually process data for the OraMedha PMS.
SCOPE: this repository — the practice-management application. The OraMedha
marketing site (oramedha.com) is a separate application with its own
dependencies (including a Google Sheets integration for demo requests) and
its own inventory; nothing here covers it.
RULE: a provider appears here only if data actually reaches it from THIS
codebase. Several vendors commonly assumed to be present are genuinely
absent, and are listed under `not_used` so an assumption can be checked
HONESTY: `dpa` records whether a Data Processing Agreement is on file.
Every entry currently reads "none-on-record". That is not a formatting
placeholder — it is the actual position, and it is the single largest
Validated by lib/__tests__/subprocessors.spec.ts, which cross-checks this
file against package.json and the source tree so a new outbound dependency
cannot be added without appearing here.

subprocessors.purpose: Primary datastore, authentication, file storage, realtime
subprocessors.region_note: Set when the project was created and readable in the Supabase dashboard (Project Settings → General). Not determinable from this repository. → REQUIRES MANUAL VERIFICATION.

evidence.notes: Deployed at dent-grow.vercel.app; next.config.ts documents Vercel's serverless body-size cap.

subprocessors.region_note: Function region is a project setting in the Vercel dashboard. → REQUIRES MANUAL VERIFICATION.

subprocessors.purpose: AI-assisted patient summaries, clinic insights, portal assistant, plain-English Business Brain explanations
subprocessors.minimisation: Patient name, phone, email and date of birth are never sent. Age is banded, last-visit is coarsened to a month, and every outbound prompt passes lib/ai/redaction.ts. Pseudonymised is NOT anonymous — a treatment history is distinctive.
subprocessors.region_note: The Developer API offers no regional pinning. Vertex AI does; migrating is the open item recorded in docs/AI-DATA-HANDLING.md.
subprocessors.training_note: Whether submitted data may be used to improve Google's models depends on the billing tier this key sits on, which has not been confirmed. This is the decisive open question.

subprocessors.purpose: Reminder messages, composed in-app and sent BY A HUMAN through a wa.me click-to-send link

evidence.notes: No API integration and no automated sending. OraMedha never transmits to Meta; it opens a link and a staff member sends the message from their own WhatsApp account.

subprocessors.status_note: Gated to development clinic IDs by WHATSAPP_ENABLED_CLINIC_IDS and asserted by lib/__tests__/business-brain-gate.spec.ts. MUST NOT be widened before communications consent is in force — data_consent_records now provides the mechanism.

subprocessors.purpose: SMTP transport for Supabase Auth emails (verification, password reset)
subprocessors.status_note: Configured only if RESEND_SMTP_PASSWORD is set and `npm run auth:email:push` has been run with a Resend provider. Unset by default, in which case Supabase's own email service carries the message and Resend receives nothing. The application never holds a mail credential or sends an email itself.

not_used.$comment: Verified absent from this repository. Listed so an assumption can be checked instead of repeated.
not_used.vercel-analytics: REMOVED. @vercel/analytics was mounted in the root layout, so it ran on the patient portal and every clinical route, sending paths containing patient and treatment UUIDs. The dependency has been uninstalled.
not_used.google-fonts-runtime: next/font/google self-hosts the typeface at build time. No runtime request reaches Google and no visitor IP is disclosed.
not_used.google-sheets: The MARKETING SITE has a Sheets integration for demo requests. This application does not, and has no googleapis dependency.
not_used.n8n: A webhook route handler exists as a skeleton and has never been written to. No n8n instance receives anything.
not_used.twilio-or-sms: absent — auth.sms is disabled in supabase/config.toml
not_used.payment-gateway: absent — no payment processor is integrated; payments are recorded, not taken
not_used.redis: absent — the rate limiter is in-process, which lib/security/rate-limit.ts states plainly

open_items: No Data Processing Agreement is on record with ANY provider above. → REQUIRES LEGAL ACTION.
Supabase and Vercel regions are unverified. → REQUIRES MANUAL VERIFICATION in each dashboard.
Google's retention and training-use position for this API key is unverified, and depends on the billing tier. → REQUIRES PROVIDER CONFIRMATION.
A published subprocessor list is a disclosure obligation under several regimes. This file is the engineering inventory it would be built from, not the published document.
